kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
wire.summary: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.

wire.title: Key leaders sound the alarm on AI. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback
wire.summary: Some key leaders at artificial intelligence companies call for a slowdown in AI development. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback as talks in Oman are delayed.

wire.title: This city led the way on reparations for Black people. Trump is trying to stop it
wire.summary: Evanston, Ill., became the first U.S. city to compensate Black people for historical discrimination. The Justice Department is trying to kill its program before other cities follow suit.

wire.title: The powerful millionaires hiding in plain sight
wire.summary: They own car dealerships, law firms, dental practices, and restaurant chains. Collectively, these overlooked business owners hold far more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and wield considerable political power.

wire.title: Beijing hits back at Anthropic CEO's call to curb China's AI development
wire.summary: China's Foreign Ministry called the Anthropic CEO's warning about the dangers of Chinese-developed AI "fearmongering," as the Chinese and U.S. leaders prepare to meet in Washington later this month.

wire.title: New Carlo Rovelli book challenges science's understanding of reality and the universe
wire.summary: In his latest book, the world-renowned physicist draws on science and philosophy to explore the notion that the university and reality are fully knowable.

wire.title: NPR looked for ChatGPT's new crisis feature. It's hard to find
wire.summary: Earlier this year, OpenAI launched a feature on ChatGPT meant to help people at risk of suicide connect with someone they trust for support. But its setup may prove challenging to someone in crisis.

wire.title: Lawmakers home in on midterm messages as Congress returns to session
wire.summary: Congress returns for a short last session ahead of the midterm election with a full plate as lawmakers look for messaging bills they can take back to voters.

wire.title: Talks between Iran and Gulf states to discuss Strait of Hormuz postponed
wire.summary: Iranian officials say a meeting with Gulf states to discuss the Strait of Hormuz has been postponed, dealing a blow to efforts to reopen the strait.

wire.title: Indonesia searches for 129 people missing after ferry capsizes in the Java Sea
wire.summary: Indonesian authorities intensified on Monday a search for people missing after a ferry overturned in bad weather in the Java Sea. At least six passengers were killed and 129 people are still missing.

wire.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
wire.summary: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.

wire.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
wire.summary: The former UK PM said: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".

wire.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
wire.summary: With more than 90% of ballots processed early on Monday, the left-wing bloc was in front by approximately 20,000 votes.

wire.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
wire.summary: Scientists say the record-breaking journey by three brothers offers hope wildlife can survive growing pressures.

wire.title: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot
wire.summary: Culiacán has seen violence skyrocket since a feud broke out between two rival factions of the Sinaloa cartel.

wire.title: Body of missing runner found in South Africa
wire.summary: A nationwide appeal was launched after Elizabeth Moselakgomo went missing last week. Four other women's bodies have been found nearby.
